mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LOGIC_CARD_POOL_BATCH (BATCH_NO, REQUEST_SEQ, CARD_TYPE, ACC_TICKET_TYPE, REQUEST_NUM, SOURCE, STATUS, OPERATOR, TOTAL_COUNT, VALID_COUNT, DUPLICATE_COUNT, INVALID_COUNT, RETRY_COUNT) VALUES (#{batchNo}, #{requestSeq}, #{cardType}, #{accTicketType}, #{requestNum}, #{source}, #{status}, #{operator}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM LOGIC_CARD_POOL_BATCH WHERE STATUS IN ('CREATED', 'REQUESTING', 'DOWNLOADING', 'IMPORTING') AND CARD_TYPE = #{cardType} ORDER BY BATCH_NO
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM LOGIC_CARD_POOL_BATCH WHERE CARD_TYPE = #{cardType} AND STATUS IN ('CREATED', 'REQUESTING', 'DOWNLOADING', 'IMPORTING')
mapper.update: UPDATE LOGIC_CARD_POOL_TYPE_LOCK SET LOCK_OWNER = #{lockOwner}, LOCK_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE CARD_TYPE = #{cardType} AND (LOCK_OWNER IS NULL OR LOCK_TIME < SYSTIMESTAMP - NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{staleSeconds}, 'SECOND'))

UPDATE LOGIC_CARD_POOL_BATCH SET STATUS = 'DOWNLOADING', RETRY_COUNT = RETRY_COUNT + 1, ERROR_MSG = NULL, FINISH_TIME = NULL WHERE BATCH_NO = #{batchNo} AND STATUS = 'FAILED' AND FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL
